Fixture: nist_estar_al_1_2.txt

Derived output from the NIST STAR 1.2 ESTAR program, written by Martin J.
Berger, National Institute of Standards and Technology, with archive source
revisions credited in ESTAR.f to Johnathan S. Coursey.

Official source archive:
https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Star/STAR.tar.gz
SHA256 b8241beb0e721b6b89dd316e32b23ac6c80e9a8908bd43da1570216de51de2c6

NIST's distribution terms and disclaimer:
https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Star/Text/download.html

This test fixture is generated output, not the original Fortran source.
It is the unchanged, byte-identical two-page output for electrons in
aluminium (material 13), calculated locally from the unchanged source.
The RADAR Python parser and tests are new derivative work, not NIST code.
No NIST endorsement or independent physical validation is claimed.
